title: Decoding Student Minds: Leveraging Conversational Agents for Psychological and Learning Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2512.10441v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper presents a psychologically-aware conversational agent designed to enhance both learning performance and emotional well-being in educational settings. The system combines Large Language Models (LLMs), a knowledge graph-enhanced BERT (KG-BERT), and a bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network with attention to classify students' cognitive and affective states in real time. Unlike prior chatbots limited to either tutoring or affective support, our approach leverages multimodal data-including textual semantics, prosodic speech features, and temporal behavioral trends-to infer engagement, stress, and conceptual understanding. A pilot study with 45 university students demonstrated improved motivation, reduced stress, and moderate academic gains compared to unimodal baselines. translated_title: 解码学生思维：利用对话代理进行心理与学习分析
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了一种具有心理感知能力的对话代理，旨在提升教育环境中的学习表现和情感健康。该系统结合了大语言模型（LLMs）、知识图谱增强的BERT（KG-BERT）以及带注意力机制的双向长短期记忆（LSTM）网络，实时分类学生的认知和情感状态。与先前仅限于辅导或情感支持的聊天机器人不同，我们的方法利用多模态数据——包括文本语义、韵律语音特征和时间行为趋势——来推断参与度、压力和概念理解程度。一项针对45名大学生的初步研究表明，与单模态基线相比，该方法改善了动机、减轻了压力，并取得了适度的学业进步。我们明确讨论了这一小样本初步研究的探索性，报告了效应大小和评分者间信度，以及显著性检验结果。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合LLM、知识图谱和注意力LSTM的心理感知对话代理，通过多模态数据实时分析学生认知与情感状态，初步实验显示其在提升动机、减轻压力方面优于单模态方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a psychologically-aware conversational agent integrating LLMs, knowledge graphs, and attention-based LSTM to analyze students' cognitive and affective states via multimodal data, showing improved motivation and reduced stress in a small pilot study.
